newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell slightly to 1.911 billion yuan from 2.09 billion yuan with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.

Trading was more active than the daily average of the past few weeks partly due to a news report that the market had admitted securities brokerages, including Shenyin and Wanguo Securities, as second-tier memebers, traders said.

The Shanghai Securities News said the market had allowed some securities houses to be regular participants trading through the short-term financial centres, money brokages run by the central bank, who are first-tier members.
A spokesman for the Shanghai branch of the People's Bank, the central bank, said that the brokerages were not newly admitted but had recently been re-registered.
"The market expects the brokerages to trade more after the re-registration, which will help boost trading," said a trader.
"This sentiment pushed the trading volume up relatively high today," he added.
Traders said they expected the rates to move narrowly in the short term due to a lack of market-moving news.
